message: 敵か味方か

name: Melilot
message: 「...You're stronger than expected. At this rate, I won't make it in time for my ride.」
Melilot-san's speed, which I had feared.
However, even that was no longer a threat to us.

name: Misa
message: 「We're pushing them back!」

name: Sally
message: 「They're totally weak!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Only defeat awaits traitors! My faith in the guidebook, which had been fading just a bit, has recovered by 3 points!」
We unleash a fierce onslaught, as if equipped with ten arms
We evade, as if equipped with ten legs
We sense everything, as if equipped with ten ears
We miss nothing, as if equipped with ten eyes.

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're the Crusaders who protect Ryuusei Town! We ain't gonna lose!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're going to tell us what's going on!」
The five of us weren't merely one times five
For the five of us, one times five had become ten, or even twenty.
Moving in perfect sync, we were like a single living creature called the Crusaders.
However, Melilot looked somewhat happy.

name: Melilot
message: 「The test is over」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is bad」
It was an explosion.
The sensation of something dense swelling up shook the night and echoed.
Centered on Melilot, a deep, jet-black darkness spread massive wings.
It was so powerful that mana, which is supposed to be invisible, distorted space and became visible.

name: Sally
message: 「E-Eeeeeek! That's not even on the same level as Boss!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is this!?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's about the same as those two presences!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-Hiding this is unfair!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is... Melilot's full power...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... aah... no, no」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka!」
Nanaka had returned to her original form.

name: Nanaka
message: 「No! No, no! I'm not like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka! Pull yourself together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No! Don't! Don't look at me, Synn!」
Nanaka covered her face and crouched down.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, get back!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't want to! Being the only useless one--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here I go.」

name: Misa
message: 「She vanished!」

name: Ria
message: 「Where did she go!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's accelerating even faster than that!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaah! Kyuu!」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte-chan!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hyaaaah! Boss! Prez, help!」

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuuuuuu...」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Gah! Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!」
As if by a magic trick, we were struck down.
When Melilot-san touched a hand to the nape of Nanaka's neck,

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka!」
Nanaka collapsed slowly into my arms.
She felt so soft.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka! Nanaka! Hang in there!」

name: Melilot
message: 「A massive amount of magical power was forcibly poured into her from the outside, numbing her consciousness. It is only temporary, so there is no need to worry.」
Nanaka's heartbeat echoed against my body.
It was a fragile feeling, like holding a treasure made of glass.

name: Melilot
message: 「Riesling should be arriving shortly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... An acquaintance of yours?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I asked her in advance to see you all home.」

name: Paqy
message: 「This woman was planning to do this from the very start.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you testing us?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You didn't transform into a Demon Lord until the very end, did you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「During the battle just now. Had you transformed into a Demon Lord, Sakura-kun, you might have been able to defeat me. Assuming you exerted your current theoretical maximum, that is.」

name: Synn
message: 「But last time, I didn't stand a chance...」

name: Melilot
message: 「During the battle just now, did you think about becoming a Demon Lord?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even though you knew your combat power would increase if you transformed?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see. There are many difficulties ahead, aren't there?」
Suddenly, a luxury foreign car glided in from the courtyard entrance and came to a stop.
It was the car used to pick up and drop off Lolotte.

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the chauffeuring to me, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good work.」

name: Helena
message: 「You certainly put on quite a flashy show.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san!? Don't tell me you saw through everything!」

name: Helena
message: 「You didn't think the Student Council would sit idly by after hearing people had gone missing, did you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Old, conniving hags--」

name: Helena
message: 「So, how did it go?」
Melilot glanced over at me and Nanaka in my arms, then immediately looked away.

name: Melilot
message: 「For the time being, excluding the two of you, I would say everyone has passed as of now」
